mutonby-openshorts-integrations-chatgpt-.description: Use OpenShorts to turn a long video (YouTube link or video file) into vertical 9:16 clips with captions and titles, restyle or re-cut those clips, and publish them to TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Use when the user wants shorts, reels or clips from a video, the best moments of a podcast or interview, or to post a clip.

mutonby-openshorts-openshorts.description: Turn long videos (podcasts, webinars, streams) into vertical 9:16 clips with subtitles, re-cut them, and publish them to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads and Bluesky via the OpenShorts API or MCP server. Use when the user wants to clip a video into shorts, find the best moments of a video, restyle captions on a clip, re-cut a clip, schedule or post clips to social platforms, or automate a clipping pipeline.
